annotations.title: Jobs by region and city in Finland

description: The JobCrawls locations hub: open jobs per region (maakunta) and in the 12 largest cities of Finland, with jobs first seen in the last 7 days, the share of jobs that do not require Finnish, the share that are remote or hybrid, the median advertised monthly pay range (the ads' low and high ends), the most advertised roles, the largest towns, and the country totals for remote and hybrid jobs and for jobs abroad. A region name returns that region with its towns and roles. A share is null when its underlying query failed. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

locale.description: Language of the result and of the linked jobcrawls.com pages. Defaults to English.

region.description: A region (maakunta) by name, slug or code, for example "Pirkanmaa", for its towns and top roles. Omit for the whole country.

name: get_locations_overview

basis.description: Where the figures come from: source, as-of date and sample.

dataUse.description: What may be reused from this result and how to credit JobCrawls.

limitReached.description: Present when a weekly limit stopped the call: which limit, its size and when it resets.

links.description: JobCrawls pages for the jobs and companies mentioned.

openInJobCrawls.description: A JobCrawls page with the full result.
